# Game Idea: Cosmic Drift

**Premise**: Players control a small spaceship drifting through an endless field of asteroids. The ship constantly drifts forward; the player can rotate left/right and apply thrust to change direction.

**Goal**: Survive as long as possible while collecting glowing energy orbs that appear randomly.

**Lose Condition**: Collision with any asteroid ends the game.

**Core Mechanics**:
- Simple joystick‑style controls (left/right rotation, thrust).
- Canvas rendering of ship, asteroids, and orbs.
- Increasing asteroid speed/density over time for difficulty ramp.
- Score based on time survived and orbs collected.

**Why Canvas?**: All graphics are 2‑D shapes and sprites drawn each frame, making it ideal for a lightweight HTML5 canvas implementation.

1: // Simple canvas game based on IDEA.md
2: (function(){
3:   const canvas=document.getElementById('game');
4:   if(!canvas){console.error('Canvas #game not found');return;}
5:   const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const W=canvas.width=canvas.clientWidth||800;
7:   const H=canvas.height=canvas.clientHeight||600;
8:   // audio setup
9:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
10:   let thrustOsc = null;
11:   const playThrust = () => {
12:     if (thrustOsc) return;
13:     thrustOsc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
14:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
15:     thrustOsc.frequency.value = 200;
16:     gain.gain.value = 0.05;
17:     thrustOsc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
18:     thrustOsc.start();
19:   };
20:   const stopThrust = () => {
21:     if (thrustOsc) {
22:       thrustOsc.stop();
23:       thrustOsc.disconnect();
24:       thrustOsc = null;
25:     }
26:   };
27:   const playCollision = () => {
28:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
29:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
30:     osc.frequency.value = 100;
31:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime);
32:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.3);
33:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
34:     osc.start();
35:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.3);
36:   };
37:   const playOrb = () => {
38:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
39:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
40:     osc.frequency.value = 400;
41:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.15, audioCtx.currentTime);
42:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.2);
43:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
44:     osc.start();
45:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.2);
46:   };
47:   // generate background stars once
48:   for(let i=0;i<100;i++){
49:     stars.push({
50:       x: Math.random()*W,
51:       y: Math.random()*H,
52:       r: Math.random()*1.5+0.5,
53:       twinkle: Math.random()*0.5+0.5
54:     });
55:   }
56: 
57:   // ---- Game objects ----
58:   const ship={x:W/2,y:H/2,angle:0,vx:0,vy:0,r:10};
59:   const asteroids=[]; // each {x,y,vx,vy,r}
60:   const orbs=[]; // each {x,y,r,ttl}
61:   const stars=[]; // background stars
62:   let keys={};
63:   let score=0, orbScore=0, start=Date.now();
64:   let gameOver=false;
65:   let asteroidSpawn=2000; // ms
66:   let lastAsteroid=Date.now();
67:   let orbSpawn=5000;
68:   let lastOrb=Date.now();
69: 
70:   // ---- Input ----
71:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
72:     keys[e.code] = true;
73:     if (e.code === 'ArrowUp') playThrust();
74:   });
75:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
76:     keys[e.code] = false;
77:     if (e.code === 'ArrowUp') stopThrust();
78:   });
79: 
80:   function update(dt){
81:     if(gameOver) return;
82:     // ship controls
83:     if(keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.angle-=0.003*dt;
84:     if(keys['ArrowRight']) ship.angle+=0.003*dt;
85:     if(keys['ArrowUp']){ // thrust
86:       ship.vx+=Math.cos(ship.angle)*0.001*dt;
87:       ship.vy+=Math.sin(ship.angle)*0.001*dt;
88:     }
89:     // move ship
90:     ship.x+=ship.vx*dt; ship.y+=ship.vy*dt;
91:     // screen wrap
92:     if(ship.x<0) ship.x+=W; if(ship.x>W) ship.x-=W;
93:     if(ship.y<0) ship.y+=H; if(ship.y>H) ship.y-=H;
94: 
95:     // spawn asteroids
96:     if(Date.now()-lastAsteroid>asteroidSpawn){
97:       const angle=Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
98:       const speed=0.05+Math.random()*0.1;
99:     asteroids.push({
100:       x: Math.random()*W,
101:       y: Math.random()*H,
102:       vx: Math.cos(angle)*speed,
103:       vy: Math.sin(angle)*speed,
104:       r: 15 + Math.random()*20,
105:       angle: Math.random()*Math.PI*2,
106:       angularVel: (Math.random()-0.5)*0.001,
107:       ttl: 0 // unused
108:     });
109:       lastAsteroid=Date.now();
110:       // increase difficulty
111:       if(asteroidSpawn>500) asteroidSpawn-=50;
112:     }
113:     // spawn orbs
114:     if(Date.now()-lastOrb>orbSpawn){
115:       orbs.push({x:Math.random()*W,y:Math.random()*H,r:5,ttl:10000});
116:       lastOrb=Date.now();
117:     }
118: 
119:     // update asteroids
120:     for(let a of asteroids){
121:       a.x+=a.vx*dt; a.y+=a.vy*dt;
122:       // rotate asteroid
123:       a.angle += a.angularVel * dt;
124:       if(a.x<0) a.x+=W; if(a.x>W) a.x-=W;
125:       if(a.y<0) a.y+=H; if(a.y>H) a.y-=H;
126:     }
127:     // update orbs ttl
128:     for(let i=orbs.length-1;i>=0;i--){
129:       const o=orbs[i];
130:       o.ttl-=dt; if(o.ttl<=0) orbs.splice(i,1);
131:     }
132: 
133:     // collisions ship-asteroid
134:     for(let a of asteroids){
135:       const dx=ship.x-a.x, dy=ship.y-a.y;
136:       const dist=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
137:       if(dist<ship.r+a.r){gameOver=true; playCollision(); break;}
138:     }
139:     // ship-orb collection
140:     for(let i=orbs.length-1;i>=0;i--){
141:       const o=orbs[i];
142:       const dx=ship.x-o.x, dy=ship.y-o.y;
143: if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)<ship.r+o.r){
144:           orbScore+=10; orbs.splice(i,1); playOrb();
145:         }
146:     }
147:     // score based on time
148:     score=Math.floor((Date.now()-start)/1000)+orbScore;
149:   }
150: 
151:   function draw(){
152:     ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
153: // ship with optional thrust flame
154:   ctx.save();
155:   ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
156:   ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
157:   // thrust flame
158:   if (keys['ArrowUp']) {
159:     ctx.beginPath();
160:     ctx.moveTo(-10, 0);
161:     ctx.lineTo(-20, -5);
162:     ctx.lineTo(-20, 5);
163:     ctx.closePath();
164:     ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
165:     ctx.fill();
166:   }
167:   // ship body
168:   ctx.beginPath();
169:   ctx.moveTo(12, 0);
170:   ctx.lineTo(-8, 6);
171:   ctx.lineTo(-8, -6);
172:   ctx.closePath();
173:   ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
174:   ctx.fill();
175:   ctx.restore();
176:     // background stars
177:     ctx.fillStyle='white';
178:     for(let s of stars){
179:       ctx.globalAlpha = s.twinkle * (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.001 + s.x + s.y));
180:       ctx.beginPath();
181:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
182:       ctx.fill();
183:     }
184:     ctx.globalAlpha = 1.0;
185:     // asteroids with rotation
186:     for(let a of asteroids){
187:       ctx.save();
188:       ctx.translate(a.x, a.y);
189:       ctx.rotate(a.angle);
190:       ctx.fillStyle = 'gray';
191:       ctx.beginPath();
192:       ctx.moveTo(a.r,0);
193:       ctx.lineTo(-a.r*0.6, a.r*0.8);
194:       ctx.lineTo(-a.r*0.6, -a.r*0.8);
195:       ctx.closePath();
196:       ctx.fill();
197:       ctx.restore();
198:     }
199:     // orbs with glow
200:     for(let o of orbs){
201:       const grad=ctx.createRadialGradient(o.x,o.y,0,o.x,o.y,o.r*3);
202:       grad.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,255,0,0.8)');
203:       grad.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,255,0,0)');
204:       ctx.fillStyle=grad;
205:       ctx.beginPath();
206:       ctx.arc(o.x,o.y,o.r,0,Math.PI*2);
207:       ctx.fill();
208:     }
209:     // UI
210:     ctx.fillStyle='white';
211:     ctx.font='16px monospace';
212:     ctx.fillText('Score: '+score,10,20);
213:     if(gameOver){
214:       ctx.textAlign='center';
215:       ctx.font='48px monospace';
216:       ctx.fillText('Game Over',W/2,H/2);
217:     }
218:   }
219: 
220:   let last=performance.now();
221:   function loop(now){
222:     const dt=now-last; last=now;
223:     update(dt);
224:     draw();
225:     if(!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
226:   }
227:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
228: })();

(End of file - total 228 lines)
</content>
